source: Spire Codex community run API (spire-codex.com), fetched 2026-09-29: /api/runs/scores/cards?stat_filter=a10_wr50&include_skip=true (wr50; the endpoint ignores character=, so every character, as in the Ironclad file), /api/runs/metrics/cards?bracket=a10&character=SILENT (winRate, n)

notes.wr50: A10 runs of every character (the scores endpoint ignores character=) by uploaders with >=50% overall win rate; elo = Codex Elo from pick-vs-alternative choices, and a Silent card is only offered to the Silent; SKIP elo 1571.3 is every character's, as in data/card-stats-a10.json. Cards with fewer than 100 picks left out.
notes.n: Silent A10 runs that picked the card
